auth.accountLocked: This account is temporarily locked. Try again shortly.
auth.accountInactive: This account is not active. Contact your administrator.

period.sealHint: Sealing cannot be undone. A sealed period refuses every posting and cannot be reopened by anybody, including a financial controller. Do it when the year has been signed off, not before.

news.archived: This notice is out of date and is kept for reference.

calendar.blurb: Semester dates and registration deadlines are read from the calendar the registration system itself enforces.

programmes.blurb: Fees shown are the approved schedule for the current intake.
programmes.empty: No programmes have been published yet.
programmes.feesUnpublished: Fees are not published for this intake — please contact the admissions office.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.name: Name
contact.subject: Subject
contact.reach: Give an email address or a telephone number so we can reply.
contact.thanks: Your message has reached us. We will reply shortly.
contact.failed: Your message could not be sent. Please try again.

noSite.title: No site is configured at this address
noSite.noHost: This request did not carry a host we recognise.

signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.invalid: That email address and password do not match an account.
signIn.locked: This account is locked for a short time after repeated failed attempts.
signIn.inactive: This account is not active. Contact your administrator.
signIn.noSite: No university is configured at this address.

mfa.heading: Verification code
mfa.hint: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.replayed: That code has already been used. Wait for the next one.
mfa.notEnrolled: This account has no authenticator enrolled.
mfa.why: Approving vouchers, releasing payments and closing periods need this. You can sign in without it and do everything else.

dashboard.heading: What you may do here
dashboard.blurb: Generated from the roles you hold. Anything not listed is not on your menu and is refused if you go to its address.
dashboard.nothing: You hold no permissions yet. An administrator assigns your role.
dashboard.mfaBanner: This session has not completed a second factor, so approvals and payments will ask for your code.

forbidden.heading: Not available to you
forbidden.body: Your roles do not include this screen. If you need it, an administrator adds the permission to your role.

pending.note: This screen arrives in phase {phase}. The function behind it is complete and tested; what is missing is the screen.

consequence.REVERSE_TERM_BILLING: The term is reversed in full
consequence.APPLY_REFUND_POLICY: The refund schedule decides what comes back

students.title: Students
students.subtitle: Search by name in either script, student number or national ID.
students.queryHint: Arabic or English. Partial names match.
students.found: {count, plural, =0 {No students match} one {# student} other {# students}}
students.name: Name

profile.subtitle: Student record
profile.blockedNote: A hold stops this student registering until it is cleared.
profile.derivedHold: Derived from the account — it lifts itself when the arrears are paid.

register.title: Registration desk
register.subtitle: Price the term, apply any discount, then commit. The figures you sign off are the figures that post.
register.optionalHint: Items the schedule marks optional. Nothing else can be declined.
register.quoteHint: Nothing has been created yet. Nothing reaches the ledger until you press Register.
register.fallbackUsed: Priced on the any-nationality row of the fee matrix.
register.needsApproval: This discount is above the {pct}% threshold. The registration will be created and held until someone with discount approval signs it; nothing posts until then.
register.donePending: Created as {no} and held for discount approval. Nothing has been posted.

registrations.title: Registrations
registrations.approveHint: You cannot approve a discount you applied yourself.
registrations.cancelHint: The billing is reversed by a linked voucher. The registration stays on file, cancelled.
registrations.cancelDateHint: Where the registration date falls in a closed period, post the reversal into an open one.

holds.title: Holds
holds.subtitle: A hold stops a student registering. Placing one states why; clearing one says who lifted it and cannot be the person who placed it.
holds.reasonHint: A student turned away from the desk has to be told what to go and fix.
holds.blocksHint: Some holds warn rather than stop.
holds.clearanceRole: Only this role may clear it

lifecycle.title: Standing, transfer and withdrawal
lifecycle.subtitle: Every change of standing states its financial consequence before it is made, not after.
lifecycle.noTransitions: This is a terminal standing. Nothing leads out of it.
lifecycle.needsApproval: This transition needs a named approver.
lifecycle.postingDateHint: Only where the effective date falls in a closed period. The academic date is unchanged either way.
lifecycle.transferHint: The old programme’s billing is reversed by a linked voucher and the new programme is billed from its own fee schedule.

documents.title: Document verification
documents.subtitle: A document is unverified until somebody other than the person who uploaded it says otherwise.
documents.satisfied: Every required document is verified and current.
documents.noExpiring: Nothing expires in the next 60 days.

medical.title: Medical records
medical.subtitle: A finding recorded on a date is what a decision taken that week was based on. Records are superseded, never edited.
medical.lapsedNote: A clearance that has run out is not a finding of unfitness — it is an examination to repeat.
medical.verdictNoteHint: Required unless the verdict is Fit.
medical.recorded: Examination recorded. The previous record has been superseded.

portalAccess.title: Portal access
portalAccess.none: Nobody can see this student's account in the portal.
portalAccess.name: Full name
portalAccess.relationshipHint: Required for a guardian - mother, father, uncle. Leave empty for the student themselves.
portalAccess.codeIssued: Give this code to the person you invited. It is shown once and cannot be shown again.
portalAccess.codeHint: Good until {date}, and can be used once.

cashier.title: Cashier desk
cashier.subtitle: Take a payment and see what it settles before it is recorded.
cashier.noCharges: Nothing outstanding. Any payment taken now becomes a credit balance.
cashier.allocateHint: Leave every box empty to settle the oldest charge first.
cashier.applyCreditHint: Money already paid, put against what is owed now. No receipt is issued: nothing entered the institution.
cashier.noTill: You have no till assigned, so cash cannot be recorded. An administrator assigns a safe account to each cashier.
cashier.daySheetHint: A running sheet, not a shift close. Nothing here is counted or signed.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.subtitle: What was taken, by whom, and against what.
receipts.cancelHint: Same day only, and only by a supervisor. After today the correction is a voucher reversal.
receipts.notToday: Issued before today, so it can no longer be cancelled.
receipts.searchHint: Receipt number, bank reference or cheque number.

cheques.title: Cheques
cheques.subtitle: The portfolio, and every movement it makes.
cheques.depositHint: One deposit slip, one voucher. The bank credits the slip as a single item, so posting per cheque would leave nothing to tie back to it.
cheques.deposited: {count} cheques sent to the bank, {total}. Voucher {voucherRef}.
cheques.clearHint: The bank paid them. This is the entry the legacy system never made.
cheques.bounceHint: The bank refused it. The debt goes back on the account and the paper goes back to the drawer.
cheques.bounced: Recorded. {reinstated} put back on the account. Voucher {voucherRef}.
cheques.handBackHint: The bank has refused nothing — this is discretionary, needs a second factor, and cannot be done by whoever took the money.

vouchers.title: Journal vouchers
vouchers.subtitle: Entries typed by hand. Everything else is posted by the module that owns the document.
vouchers.draftHint: A draft may be incomplete and unbalanced. Balance is required at submission, where it is you saying the voucher is finished.
vouchers.submitted: Submitted. It is now with a reviewer.
vouchers.abandoned: Abandoned. It stays on the record with its number.
vouchers.abandonHint: Nothing is deleted. A gap in the voucher numbers is a question somebody will ask.
vouchers.frozen: Submitted, so its lines can no longer be changed.
vouchers.notYours: Made by someone else, so only they may edit it.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Vouchers waiting on your signature — and only those you may act on.
approvals.rejectHint: The comment is the whole message the maker gets. "Rejected" on its own teaches people to resubmit unchanged.
approvals.mfaNeeded: Approving posts money to the ledger, so it needs your authenticator code first.

tills.title: Cash tills
tills.subtitle: Which safe each cashier’s cash is recorded in.
tills.noCashiers: Nobody holds a cashiering role yet.
tills.warning: A cashier with no till cannot take cash — the refusal happens at the counter, in front of a student.
tills.perCashier: One safe per cashier, so "who is short today" is a question the ledger can answer.

structure.title: Academic structure
structure.subtitle: Faculties, programmes, batches and the academic calendar — each a row with an identity, not a name repeated on other rows.
structure.neverDeleted: Structure is withdrawn, never deleted. The legacy build deleted a batch with no check for the students admitted under it.
structure.notFiscal: An academic year is not a fiscal year. The two calendars meet only at a posting’s document date.

feeMatrix.title: Fee matrix
feeMatrix.subtitle: What a cohort is priced at, version by version. Nothing is overwritten and nothing is deleted.
feeMatrix.noHistory: No schedule has been drafted for this cohort yet.
feeMatrix.chooseCohort: Choose a programme, a batch and an admission category.
feeMatrix.approved: Approved. Version {versionNo} is in force from {from}.
feeMatrix.superseded: It closed version {versionNo} the day before.
feeMatrix.noLines: A schedule with no lines bills nothing and looks exactly like a correct one, so it is refused.
feeMatrix.copiedFrom: Copied from version {versionNo}. Adjust and save.
feeMatrix.approveHint: Approval closes whichever version this one replaces — the day before it opens. Every registration raised while the old version was in force still resolves to the old figures.
feeMatrix.notApprover: Preparing a schedule and approving it are different people. You may draft this one; somebody else puts it in force.

capacity.title: Seat capacity
capacity.subtitle: How many places each programme has for an intake, and how many are already spoken for.
capacity.noQuotas: No quota has been set for this intake. Until one is, nothing limits how many offers go out.
capacity.heldHint: An offer nobody has replied to is not a free seat. Available subtracts reserved seats and unanswered offers both.
capacity.immutable: A quota’s programme, intake and category cannot be changed — moving it sideways would move every offer counted against it. Only the seat count is adjustable.

committee.title: Admissions committee
committee.subtitle: The ranked list for one programme and intake, the decision on each applicant, and the offer that follows it.
committee.chooseCohort: Choose a programme and an intake.
committee.noApplicants: Nobody has applied to this programme for this intake.
committee.failsShown: Applicants who failed screening are listed and marked, not hidden. A committee that cannot see the near-misses cannot exercise the discretion it exists for.
committee.rationaleHint: Mandatory, in the database as well as here. An unexplained refusal is the one the applicant will come back and ask about.
committee.rescreenHint: Re-runnable. A corrected certificate score is re-screened by running this again; the previous verdict is replaced.
committee.decisionIsNotOffer: Recording a decision does not issue an offer. Deciding and having a seat are different questions, and collapsing them is how the legacy build over-admitted.
committee.noOffers: No offer has been issued for this programme and intake.
committee.depositHint: The deposit is a real receipt taken at the cashier desk, not a flag set here. The money and the seat are two facts, and the offer ties them together.
committee.overrideReason: Why the quota is being exceeded
committee.overrideHint: Needs its own permission and a second factor, and the reason is recorded on the offer itself. Recording that capacity was exceeded without recording why is indistinguishable from never having checked.
committee.noWaitlist: Nobody is waitlisted for this programme.
committee.promoteHint: A freed seat is offered by a person, not by a rule. An offer is a commitment to somebody, and the institution should make it deliberately.
committee.promotedInto: Replaced a seat that came free.

sponsors.title: Sponsors
sponsors.subtitle: Who is paying part of a student’s fees, under what contract, and what they still owe.
sponsors.bothNames: A sponsor needs a name in both languages: an invoice to a ministry is issued in Arabic and audited in English.
sponsors.noSponsors: No sponsor has been recorded yet.
sponsors.drafted: Drafted with {lineCount} coverage line(s). It funds nothing until it is activated.
sponsors.activateHint: The second signature. A draft is refused as firmly as an expired contract, so one somebody typed and nobody approved cannot quietly start paying students’ fees.
sponsors.endHint: Ended, not deleted, and the range it was in force for is kept: charges already split under it stay attributed to the sponsor.
sponsors.noContracts: No contract has been drafted yet.
sponsors.emptyContract: A contract with no coverage lines funds nothing, and looks exactly like a contract.
sponsors.invoiceHint: Only shares that are not already on an invoice are picked up, so running the consolidation again cannot bill a sponsor twice for the same term.
sponsors.agingHint: Aged from the invoice due date. Shares nobody has invoiced sit in the current bucket however old the charge is — a sponsor is not late for a bill nobody sent them.

scholarships.title: Scholarships
scholarships.subtitle: The schemes, what each has left to give, and every award made against them.
scholarships.noSchemes: No scheme has been created yet.
scholarships.capHint: A scheme with a budget refuses the award that would exceed it, at approval. A scheme without one is a promise nobody has costed.
scholarships.proposed: Proposed. It covers nothing until it is approved.
scholarships.makerChecker: Proposing and approving are different permissions. A scholarship is money the institution gives away, and one person deciding it alone is the exposure maker-checker exists for.
scholarships.noAwards: No award has been made against this scheme.

users.title: People
users.subtitle: Who can sign in, and what their roles let them do.
users.sodHint: The roles are checked together, against the person. Two individually clean roles can combine into a conflict — a cashier role and a supervisor role each pass, and together let one person take a payment and cancel it.
users.legacy: The legacy user table held the password in clear and a privilege column with two possible values that nothing ever read.
users.passwordHint: Set once, here, and never shown again. It is hashed with Argon2id before it reaches the database.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: What each role may do. Checked against the segregation matrix when it is saved, not when it is used.
roles.noRoles: No role has been created yet.
roles.sodMatrix: The matrix refuses a conflicting pair at save time. A control that only fires when somebody tries to misuse the role has already failed — the role existed for months and was being used all along.
roles.legacy: There was no role table. `Priv` held one of two strings typed into a combo box, was read at sign-in, and was never consulted again anywhere in the application.

branding.title: Identity
branding.subtitle: The colours, the fonts and the marks this university renders in — on its website and in this console alike.
branding.fontHint: Chosen from the faces shipped with the product. A font named but not shipped renders as the browser’s fallback, which for Arabic is usually wrong and always ugly.
branding.inkHint: Text colour is derived from the lightness of each colour, not configured. A palette that lets somebody choose white on yellow is a palette that will eventually be given one.
branding.urlHint: A URL for now. The upload endpoint that would put the file here does not exist in any phase yet — see the note in §8.1.
branding.httpsOnly: https only, enforced by the database. A social link is a footer element on every page, which makes it the least-examined link on the site.

content.title: Website content
content.subtitle: The landing page, the news and the calendar entries the public site renders.
content.archived: Archived. It stays reachable at its own address.
content.bothLanguages: Publishing needs both languages complete. A half-translated page on a public site is worse than one that is not there.
content.derivedHint: Semester dates and the registration deadline are read from the academic calendar and cannot be typed here. The website must not be able to disagree with the system about when registration closes.
content.richTextHint: Stored and rendered as plain paragraphs. HTML from an editor has to be sanitised before it reaches a public page, and shipping the storage before the sanitiser is how a CMS becomes a delivery mechanism.

enquiries.title: Enquiries
enquiries.subtitle: What the contact form on the public site has collected.
enquiries.subject: Subject
enquiries.handledHint: Any status but new demands a handler and a timestamp, by constraint. "Closed by nobody at no time" is not a state this table can hold.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every recorded action, in order, hash-chained so a deletion cannot be silent.
audit.verifyHint: Each entry carries the hash of the one before it, so removing or altering one breaks every link after it. A failure here is an alert, not a log line.

vendors.title: Suppliers
vendors.subtitle: Who the institution buys from, and where their money goes.
vendors.noVendors: No supplier has been recorded yet.
vendors.blocked_: Blocked. No payment can be raised against them.
vendors.requested: Proposed. It takes effect when a second person approves it.
vendors.pendingChanges: Bank changes awaiting a second signature
vendors.bankFraudHint: Proposing a change to where a supplier’s money goes is half of the highest-value fraud in accounts payable; approving one is the other half. Both need a second factor, and they may not be the same person.

orders.title: Purchase orders
orders.subtitle: What has been ordered, what it was approved against, and what is still to arrive.
orders.encumbrance: Approving an order commits budget. That commitment is released as goods arrive and as the invoice lands, so an order is never counted twice.
orders.makerChecker: Raising an order and approving one are different permissions, and the approver may not be the person who raised it.

receiving.title: Goods received
receiving.subtitle: Confirming what actually arrived, against what was ordered.
receiving.noOrders: No approved order is waiting for delivery.
receiving.independence: Confirming delivery is the one independent piece of evidence in the three-way match. It is worth nothing if the person giving it also placed the order or waived the bill, which is why the Stores Officer role holds this and nothing else.
receiving.neverMore: Never more than is still outstanding on the line. Over-receipt is refused rather than warned about.

invoices.title: Supplier invoices
invoices.subtitle: The bill, matched against the order and the delivery before it can be paid.
invoices.threeWay: Order, delivery, invoice. A mismatch holds the invoice rather than blocking it — somebody with authority may still approve it, with a reason, and the reason is stored.
invoices.nonPoHint: A utility bill has no order to match against. It still needs an account and an approver.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Paying suppliers — proposed, approved by a second person, and posted.
payments.mfaHint: Approving a payment moves money out of the institution, so it needs your authenticator code first.
payments.blockedVendor: A blocked supplier cannot be paid, and a supplier whose bank details are awaiting approval cannot be paid to the proposed account.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.subtitle: What was allocated, what is committed, what is spent, and what is left.
budgets.encumbranceHint: Committed is what approved orders have reserved and not yet consumed. A budget that shows only what has been spent tells a manager there is money that is already promised.

assets.title: Fixed assets
assets.subtitle: What the institution owns, what it cost, and what it is worth now.
assets.legacy: There was no asset entity at all. An asset was a row in the chart of accounts carrying a depreciation percentage: no purchase date, no serial number, no custodian, and no accumulated-depreciation account — so net book value was the original cost, for ever.

periods.title: Fiscal periods
periods.subtitle: Which months accept postings, and which are sealed.
periods.noPeriods: No fiscal year has been opened.
periods.closeHint: Closing a period refuses every posting dated inside it. Correcting a January error in March belongs in March — back-dating it into a closed January is exactly what the lock exists to prevent.

trialBalance.title: Trial balance
trialBalance.subtitle: Opening, movement and closing for every account in the window.

statements.title: Financial statements
statements.subtitle: Where the institution stands, and what it earned getting there.
statements.comparative: Compare with the same window last year

aging.title: Aged receivables and payables
aging.subtitle: Who owes what, and for how long. Three ledgers, three clocks.

reconciliation.title: Sub-ledger reconciliation
reconciliation.subtitle: Every control account against the sub-ledger that explains it.

studentAccount.title: Statement of account
studentAccount.subtitle: One student's charges, receipts and running balance.
studentAccount.chooseStudent: Choose a student to produce a statement.
studentAccount.noDirectory: Open this screen from a student's record to produce their statement.

discounts.title: Discount exposure
discounts.subtitle: What the institution gave away, and to whom.

print.voidedCancelled: This receipt was cancelled on {date}. It is not proof of payment.
print.voidedDishonoured: The cheque behind this receipt was returned by the bank on {date}. It is not proof of payment.
print.notPosted: This voucher has not been approved. It is a draft, and nothing has been posted to the ledger.
print.verifyHint: Scan to verify this card against the university's own records.
print.offerBody: Following consideration of your application, the university is pleased to offer you a place on the programme named below for the {batch} intake.
print.offerConditions: This offer is conditional. It stands only once the following have been satisfied:
print.offerDeposit: A seat deposit of {amount} is payable on acceptance. The place is not held until it is received.
print.offerDeadline: This offer must be accepted in writing by {date}. After that date the place is released to another applicant.
print.offerClosing: We look forward to welcoming you.
print.offerWithdrawn: This offer is no longer open. It is reproduced here as a record of what was issued.
print.invoiceTerms: Payable by {date}. Please quote the invoice number on your remittance.
print.cancelledInvoice: This invoice was cancelled. It is reproduced here as a record.

apply.title: Apply for admission
apply.blurb: Four short steps. Nothing is submitted until you have read it back at the end.

closed.blurb: Applications are not open at the moment. When the next intake opens it will be announced here and on the university's news page.

intake.categoryHint: Choose the channel you are applying through. It decides which fee schedule and which seat allocation apply to you, so choosing the wrong one delays your application.

identity.nameHint: Exactly as it appears on your passport or national ID. Your offer letter and your certificate are issued in both languages.
identity.idHint: Give at least one. It is how the university tells two applicants with the same name apart.
identity.reachHint: Give at least one. An offer that cannot be sent to you is an offer you will not receive.

certificate.scoreHint: Choose your certificate first and this will show what it is marked out of.
certificate.subjectsHint: Separated by commas. Used to check the subject requirements of the programmes you choose.
certificate.documentsLater: Do not send documents yet. Bring the originals of your certificate and your ID when the university calls you in; nothing is uploaded through this form.

choices.title: Programme choices
choices.blurb: Rank the programmes you want in order. Your first choice is considered first; the others are considered if it is full or you are not eligible for it.
choices.duplicateHint: The same programme cannot be chosen twice. Ranking a programme against itself has no meaning.

review.title: What you are submitting
review.declaration: By submitting you confirm that what you have entered is true. An application found to contain a false statement is refused, and an admission obtained by one is withdrawn.
review.discard: Clear this form and start again

receipt.title: Your application has been received.
receipt.blurb: It is now with the admissions committee. You will be contacted using the email address or telephone number you gave.
receipt.keepIt: Keep both of these. You need them together to check your application, and the tracking code is shown only once — the university cannot show it to you again.

errors.noSite: No university is configured at this address.
errors.incomplete: Some of the form is not filled in. Please go back through the steps.
errors.failed: That could not be submitted. Please try again in a moment.

status.title: Check your application
status.blurb: Enter the application number and the tracking code you were given when you applied.
status.tokenHint: The 32-character code shown once when you submitted.
status.advisoryNote: A decision is taken by the admissions committee. Until one is recorded, this page shows only that your application has been received.

offer.title: You have been made an offer.
offer.acceptBy: You must reply by {date}. After that date the place is offered to another applicant.
offer.howTo: Contact the admissions office to accept. Bring your original certificate and identification.

errors.noSite: No university is configured at this address.
errors.notFound: No application matches that number and code. Check both and try again.
errors.failed: That could not be checked. Please try again in a moment.

verify.title: Registration card verification
verify.footer: This page is produced by the university's own records at the moment you opened it. It shows no financial information.

portal.footer: This page shows your own record at the university. If a figure looks wrong, bring this page to the finance office.

errors.invalid: That email address and password do not match.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in a quarter of an hour.
errors.inactive: That account is closed. Ask the registry office.
errors.noAccess: This account is not linked to any student. Ask the registry office.
errors.noSite: No university is configured at this address.

activate.heading: Set up your portal account
activate.blurb: The registry office gives you a code when they grant you access. It is good for a fortnight and can be used once.
activate.passwordHint: At least 12 characters, with an upper-case letter, a lower-case letter and a digit.

errors.badCode: That code is not valid. It may have expired or already been used.
errors.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.weak: That password does not meet the policy.
errors.noSite: No university is configured at this address.

overview.blocked: You cannot register at the moment
overview.noSchedule: No instalment plan on your account.
overview.noRegistration: You have not registered for a term yet.
overview.documentsDone: Every required document is on file.
overview.noApplication: No application is linked to your record.

account.howToPay: Payment online is not available yet. Pay at the cashier's office or by the bank transfer details the finance office gives you, and quote your student number.
account.noCharges: Nothing has been billed to your account.

statement.title: Statement of account
statement.empty: There is nothing on your account for this period.

instalments.behind: Some of what was scheduled has not reached the university. Settle it or agree a revised plan with the finance office.
instalments.notBehind: A date that has passed does not mean money is owed. Nothing on your account is overdue.
instalments.noPlan: There is no instalment plan on your account. The whole balance is payable as billed.

registrations.none: You have not registered for a term yet.
registrations.cardHint: This is the same card the registry office issues. Whoever it is shown to can check it by the code on it.

documents.outstanding: Some required documents are still missing or need renewing.
documents.none: Your programme does not list any required documents.
documents.howToSubmit: Documents cannot be uploaded here yet. Bring the originals to the registry office, where they will be copied and verified.

settings.title: Your account
settings.name: Name
settings.accessNote: Access is granted and withdrawn by the registry office. Ask them if this list is wrong.
settings.changed: Your password has been changed. Any other device signed in to this account has been signed out.

errors.noSite: No university is configured at this address.
errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.weak: That password does not meet the policy.
